scope: Corollary E.9 (Near-minimizers for a height) of the manuscript “Uniform Cartier sections for Fano type contractions” (preprints/Uniform-Cartier-sections-for-Fano-type-contractions-September-25-2026/Uniform-Cartier-sections-for-Fano-type-contractions-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 066 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d97ba60373419ba), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 71. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an allowed height b and normalize its common rays by b = 1. If wi, vi have functional values within relative o(1) of the minimum, then wi = (1+o(1))vi on all regular functions, with an error independent of the function. The same conclusion, after A = 1 normalization, holds for minimizers of heights whose coefficients converge to those of b.
